context_and_flow.ux_intent: To prompt the user to sign in to their Fitbit account, likely during initial app installation or after being logged out.
ux_patterns: The illustration is a flat, 2D character-focused art style.
The artwork is placed at the top of the screen to serve as a hero visual, emphasizing movement.
Color palette is high-contrast, utilizing a vibrant teal background.
Design elements include rounded corners on buttons and a consistent sans-serif typeface.
Layout is vertically centered for mobile accessibility.

interaction_elements: Design elements include rounded corners on buttons and a consistent sans-serif typeface.
